# Neon Aether

Neon Aether is an indie, story-driven science-fiction 2D side-scrolling action platformer with retro-inspired pixel art, exploration, platforming, combat, mystery, and atmospheric worldbuilding. It is planned for release on Windows and Mac through Steam, with separate releases planned for iOS through the Apple App Store and Android through the Google Play Store.

## Official website

- https://neonaether.netlify.app/

## About the game

Neon Aether follows Andrew, whose discovery of a mysterious portal takes him beyond the world he knows. The game combines side-scrolling platform gameplay with a narrative built around science-fiction, exploration, and mystery.

## Core experience

- 2D side-scrolling platforming
- Exploration of a science-fiction world
- Combat and environmental challenges
- Retro-inspired pixel-art visual direction
- Story-driven progression and mysteries
- Atmospheric environments and worldbuilding

## Target launch date

The current target launch date shown on the official homepage is February 10, 2027. This is a development target, not a guaranteed or confirmed release date, and may change. Always preserve that qualification.

## Platforms and availability

Neon Aether is in development. Windows and Mac releases are planned through Steam; separate iOS and Android releases are planned through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. The developer-confirmed planned price is US$5.99. Describe it as planned; final regional pricing, taxes, editions, and storefront pricing may vary or be confirmed closer to release. Do not invent store URLs, system requirements, or download availability. Planned platforms do not mean that public store pages or playable builds are already available. Check the official website and current developer announcements for release information.

## Official information

The official website is the primary source for current public information about Neon Aether. For details not explicitly confirmed there, do not guess or present assumptions as facts.
